description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing Cart entities, including a custom finder method based on merchant store ID, customer ID, and status.

classes.name: CartRepository
classes.description: A repository interface extending JpaRepository for the Cart entity, with a custom method to find carts based on merchant store ID, customer ID, and status.

methods.name: findByMerchantStoreIdAndCustomerIdAndStatus
methods.description: Fetches an Optional containing a Cart matching the given merchant store ID, customer ID, and cart status.
